study type: Nested case-control analysis within a randomized controlled trial
outcome: Duration of high-dependency nursery admission (>24h vs <=24h)
cohort: Pregnant women with GDM risk factors, singleton pregnancies, and less than 20 weeks' gestation at screening, recruited from 17 hospitals.
finding: Identifying and treating early Gestational diabetes mellitus (eGDM) reduces the risk of neonatal respiratory distress (NRD), which is also associated with Caesarean section, large for gestational age, and shorter gestation.
mod_finding: Neonatal respiratory distress was associated with Caesarean section (2.31, 1.42-3.76).
followup_time: Postpartum (duration of respiratory support and nursery stay for NRD/RDS)
birth_weight: N/A (Large for gestational age is a factor, but not the overall birth weight range)
gest_age: N/A (Population recruited at <20 weeks' gestation, and 'shorter gestation' was identified as a risk factor for NRD, but the gestational age range of the delivered babies is not specified)
